name: emet-cli
description: The emet CLI runtime, installed to ~/.claude/emet
author: Andry Orellana <hello@andryore.dev>
//: Standalone tool tree for the global `emet` CLI (`~/.claude/emet`). Not published, not part of any project's dependency graph — just a package root so `bun install` can pull @types/bun + @types/node and `bun test` has somewhere to root itself.
